# Digital ADN — QR Code Digital Côte d’Ivoire

> Digital ADN aide les entreprises en Côte d’Ivoire à digitaliser la présentation de leurs offres, les commandes, le suivi commercial et certains processus internes.

Canonical site: https://qrcodedigital.com/
Primary market: Côte d’Ivoire
Base: Abidjan
Language: French (fr-CI)
Contact WhatsApp: +225 07 79 01 92 55

## Core catalogue solutions

Digital ADN sells three catalogue/menu QR packs. These catalogue packs DO NOT include artificial intelligence.

### Pack Starter
- Installation: 15,000 XOF
- Subscription: 4,900 XOF/month
- Catalogue or menu accessible by QR code
- WhatsApp cart
- 3 physical QR cards

### Pack Pro
- Installation: 30,000 XOF
- Subscription: 14,900 XOF/month
- POS order taking
- Structured order management
- 5 physical QR cards

### Pack Business
- Installation: 60,000 XOF
- Subscription: 29,900 XOF/month
- Stock management
- Real-time CRM synchronization
- 10 physical QR cards

### Optional hardware
- Bluetooth/USB 58 mm thermal printer: 35,000 XOF

## Premium services

These are separate from the catalogue packs:
- Professional business website, from 150,000 XOF
- WhatsApp AI agent, priced on request
- Custom management application, priced after needs analysis

## Typical customers
- Restaurants
- Bars
- Maquis
- Lounges
- Shops and retail businesses
- Hotels and residences
- Service businesses
- SMEs in Côte d’Ivoire

## Editorial focus

The blog answers practical questions about catalogue digital, menu QR, WhatsApp selling, POS ordering, stock management, CRM, websites, WhatsApp AI agents, custom business applications and SME digitalisation in Côte d’Ivoire.
